title: feat: add Gemini 3.8 TTS with Google primary and OpenRouter fallback
author: tomdacatto
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #15495

- Adds `google/gemini-3.8-flash-tts` and `google/gemini-3.8-flash-lite-tts`: Google publisher/provider, Gemini Developer API `/v1beta/interactions` primary with bare upstream IDs; no aliases, paid-only, multiplier 1, no Pollinations GPU. Tested Vertex routes returned 404.
- Adds hidden OpenRouter `/audio/speech` fallback pinned to `google-ai-studio`, with provider fallbacks disabled. Bills reported Google usage or OpenRouter generation-record native tokens; rejects invalid usage/audio. Supports 30 voices, style instructions, WAV default and PCM; rejects unsupported explicit formats.
- Prices: $0.50/M text input, $9/M Flash or $6/M Lite audio output through 2026-12-31 ([Google pricing](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing)). Fallback costs include 5.5%; customers retain primary pricing, so Pollinations absorbs the premium. Both routes use Google inference.
- Verified locally: 233 automated tests, both service typechecks, 120 live voice checks, native/speech/chat/Responses routes, permissions/errors, 10,000-character inputs, cache and disconnect/rejoin with one debit/event. Reconciled 83 Google and 78 fallback billed events; all 78 OpenRouter generation records matched.
- Merge gates: Google invoice export reconciliation; approved `GEMINI_API_KEY` provisioning/mapping; fresh CI/current-main validation. Fallback adds usage-lookup latency; longest Lite request took 253s. Repeated-text fidelity remains uncertain; production concurrency unproven. No remote deployment or secret changes performed.

gist.headline: The hive finds its voice
gist.blurb: Two Gemini text-to-speech models join the audio API, with 30 voices to choose from. Polli has already started narrating the garden.
gist.summary: Added paid-only `google/gemini-3.8-flash-tts` and `google/gemini-3.8-flash-lite-tts`, using Google's Interactions API first and a Google AI Studio-pinned OpenRouter fallback for speech generation.
gist.impact: Developers can generate WAV or PCM speech in 30 voices, add style instructions, and use either model through the audio API with fallback when the primary route is unavailable.
gist.visual_concept: Gemini text-to-speech is the subject: a cozy microphone and retro audio terminal turn written words into soft sound waves and blooming flowers. Polli wears tiny headphones and listens beside a CRT monitor robot displaying two voice tracks, suggesting the primary and fallback routes without implying a separate model mascot.
